about: Every number in the one-page summary, with its n and where it came from. Edit here, then run ./build.sh.

comparisons.about: Student alone (no teacher takeover) on sealed held-out seeds 1-20 (40 for the two new placements). Each row changes one thing against its control. Successes / (n - errored); 0 errored everywhere.

curve.about: Learning curve on the showcase task: the student trained on the first K accepted demos by seed, from the same 56. Same laptop and fine-tune code; the 56 point is the showcase fine-tune itself (1255.3 s), 14 and 28 were trained separately (runs curve-k14, curve-k28).

latency.about: Decision latency, median and p95. Edge budget: 2 s per decision and 3 GB (SPEC section 6.10).

rows.label: Student, showcase exam
rows.source: showcase exam on the RTX 5070 Ti (WS1 scratchpad old/exam_events.jsonl + exam_moved_events.jsonl): 326 decisions, median 311.9 ms, p95 556.5 ms (nearest rank), 1 over 2 s, 0 Argon calls; recomputed here
